description: Answers "how do I…" questions about the livedot family from its own published help: Windline (cycling), RunFast (running), livedot.me (following people live, organisers), livedot for Good (charities) and AdventureLive (adventures tracked by inReach, SPOT or Garmin LiveTrack). E.g. how do I connect my Garmin, how does a charity apply for livedot for Good, how do I link my inReach, how do followers see my race. Returns the best article's own summary (quote it as the answer), its own numbered steps when it has them, its link and which app it is for, plus up to three more. Never add steps the article doesn't give and never answer from memory instead: if the answer isn't in it, say so and give the link.

app.description: Only one app's help: windline (cycling), runfast (running), livedot, good (livedot for Good, charities) or adventurelive. Leave it out to search them all.

question.description: The question as the user asked it, e.g. "how do I add my LiveTrack address".

name: help_guides

outputSchema.description: The family's own help article for a question: its summary, its steps and its link.

app.description: The app asked about, or null.

article.description: The best match: title, source (windline, runfast, livedot, good, adventurelive), app (the app it is for), summary (the article's own words: quote it), steps ([{ name?, text }]: the article's own steps, or none), steps_heading, url, updated.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user.

more.description: Other articles that may answer it: title, app, summary, url.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: a free account link, when the server adds one.

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Find a help article
